code: // Own the one local static object.

overview.explanation: Dashed dependency arrows are borrowed access, not ownership transfer. Neither first nor second owns or deletes the dispenser. The static local object has program-managed lifetime. The take box is an operation view, not another object; its comment explains the separate synchronization rule.

focus.title: Construct once, then lend the same object
focus.what: This accessor creates one local static service and returns a borrowed reference.
focus.where: The public access point for the otherwise privately constructed type.
focus.why: Callers need one shared instance without becoming its owners.
focus.invariant: Every successful accessor return names the same live object in this executable.
focus.risk: Once-only initialization does not protect later changes to members.
explain: Declare a class-level function returning a reference to the dispenser.
The comment identifies initialization on first use.
Create a local static object once and keep its storage beyond the call.
Return a borrowed reference to that object.
Begin the separate ticket operation; its lock is shown in the next block.

focus.title: Protect the complete state change
focus.what: This critical section checks availability and reserves one ticket as one operation.
focus.why: A unique instance still needs synchronized mutable access.
focus.invariant: No successful call can observe or reserve the same next_ value as another protected call.
focus.risk: Moving the increment outside the guarded scope separates checking from reservation.
explain: The comment states the synchronization boundary.
Declare a scoped mutex guard type.
Acquire gate_ by constructing the guard named lock.
Check whether all three tickets have been issued.
Supply its message and throw; guard cleanup will release the lock.
Return the old counter value and increment it before leaving the guarded scope.
